about.text: A firm, elastic, mild and slightly acidic cow's-milk cheese of north-east Brazil that squeaks when bitten and browns without melting, so it is grilled on skewers over charcoal. Brazilian law (IN 30/2001) defines it as a cheese sold within about ten days of making.

links.name: MAPA IN 30/2001, Anexo II (Queijo de coalho)

facts.v: Medium to high moisture, semi-hard elastic paste, thin rind
Now also made industrially and sold in almost all Brazilian states
A square block about 20–22 cm long, 12–13 cm wide and 3–4 cm high, set on skewers for grilling
